input.content:
I'm sorry you're still running into trouble, Sofia — I know this is already a frustrating situation. Unfortunately, when I pull up the account details under the name and zip code you provided, the system isn't returning a matching account, so I can't access your order just yet.

Could you please double-check the zip code on file (or try another zip you may have used, like a previous address)? Alternatively, if you can locate the email address on your account — for example, from your order confirmation email — I can look you up that way.

Once we get you verified, I'll be glad to process the return for the damaged bike right away.
